slides.title:
This year, let your kid
make the **show**.
slides.tab: A weekend project for you two

slides.title: Pick a **family story**
slides.body: The year the pie fell. Grandpa's dog. The road trip nobody forgets.

slides.title: Your kid **draws** one scene
slides.body: Paper and crayons. Their version of the story, not yours.

slides.title: Bring it to **life**
slides.body: Turn the drawing into a short cartoon. Let them record the voice themselves.
slides.example: In our course, that's one lesson: “Their own cartoon. With their own voice in it.”

slides.title: **Play it** after dinner
slides.body: On the TV, for the whole table. Then watch grandma's face.

slides.title:
Save this for
**Thanksgiving week**.
